title: AI Diligence Statement
description: How Osman Academy used AI in building this site and curriculum, and the editorial standards we hold ourselves to.
html:
Osman Academy / Legal / AI Diligence Statement

AI Diligence Statement

Last updated: August 2026

In the development of the Osman Academy website and the Practical AI Skills Program curriculum, we engaged in extensive collaboration with Claude from Anthropic.

Throughout this process, Claude assisted with structural development, content drafting, design, critiquing, editing, and rewriting. The Osman Academy team wrote, directed, edited, and provided continual vision, expertise, critical judgment, and domain knowledge, and made all final decisions about both content and approach.

All AI-generated and co-created content underwent thorough validation, editing, and curation by the Osman Academy team. The final materials accurately reflect our understanding, expertise, and intended pedagogical approach. While AI assistance was instrumental in producing this website and curriculum, Osman Academy maintains full editorial responsibility for the content — meaning we stand behind it as our own work, not the AI's. This is separate from the legal terms governing use of this Site, which are set out in our Disclaimer.

This disclosure is made in the spirit of transparency and to acknowledge the evolving role of AI in educational content development and other creative and intellectual work.
